question: Which among the following teams won the SAFF (South Asian Football Federation) Championship Women 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a momentous triumph at the **Dashrath Rangshala Stadium in Kathmandu, Nepal,** **Bangladesh** achieved an unprecedented victory at the **SAFF Women's Championship,** clinching their inaugural title.
 
• The Bangladesh team exhibited exceptional football skills, captivating a packed stadium, as they secured a remarkable **3-1 win** over the host **nation, Nepal, in the final match**.
 
• **Sabina Khatun, the captain of Bangladesh, **emerged as the tournament's leading goal scorer with an impressive tally of eight goals in five matches. In a heartfelt gesture, she dedicated the well-deserved trophy to the people of Bangladesh, symbolizing their collective achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• T**he SAFF Women's Championship of 2022** marked the tournament's** sixth edition,** a prestigious international women's football championship that brings together national teams from the **South Asian Football Federation**. 
 
• Held in **Kathmandu, Nepal**, the thrilling competition unfolded from **September 6 to September 19, 2022.**
